scope: Project-key rotation, encrypted document recovery and verified storage-security copy

verified_production_controls.filesystem: ProtectSystem=strict with limited state write paths
verified_production_controls.ssh: key authentication, no password or root login
verified_production_controls.application_kms_policy: Encrypt and Decrypt on document key only, production application context, no groups or attached policies
verified_production_controls.backup_writer: PutObject daily prefix and GenerateDataKey via S3 only
verified_production_controls.backup_bucket: SSE-KMS, full public access block, 30-day Object Lock governance

limits: The production application and customer documents were not changed.
The real KMS and off-site restore drill used synthetic documents only, not a complete production service restore.
Project rotation is atomic maintenance work and holds the SQLite writer lock; it is not a zero-downtime scheduled job.
The 2000-document run used small 3600-byte bodies and is not a throughput guarantee for 100000 documents.
Workspace-value keys and replacement of a KMS root ARN are separate migrations.
References to AWS mechanisms are not certification or an independent audit.
